verdict: Useful tested local-authoring foundation; not yet demonstrated high-tier maturity or universal professional capability.

observed_mechanisms: Explicit process entry conditions and handoffs
Skill behavior testing separate from infrastructure testing
Session bootstrap and client adapters in the reference repository
superpowers_comparison.adaptation: Four process skills, on-demand technical references, direct craft guidance and evidence-based regression tests. No unconditional all-session bootstrap or approval chain added.
superpowers_comparison.limit: This audit reads the checked-out source; it does not independently certify Superpowers reliability or rank either plugin.

criteria.evidence_or_gap: Descriptions are task-specific; native automatic triggering and rejection of unrelated requests have not been tested across clients.
Original moth brief became a local editable artifact; bounded repair preserved appearance. New-work creative reference is now required, with narrow edits excluded.
Four public skills; focused Editor decision probe loaded two. No controlled token-cost or context-pressure benchmark.
CLI 1.3.0 help/docs/schema used in actual runs. Stable craft is written directly and skills have no routine web links.
Live MCP session_info succeeded with no open tabs. list_artboards returned No file context available. No mutation or export attempted.
Source ownership and preservation are specified; conflicting local/remote reconciliation has not been executed.
Native editable moth paths rendered. Contour and negative-space guidance strengthened; broad shape/style proficiency remains unbenchmarked.
Moth source preserves layered artwork; read/inspect guidance exists. Large nested component projects are not exercised.
Original center click worked while visible forewing click failed. Updated review requirements and live repair verified 38 positive, negative, repeat and interruption sequences.
Input-name mismatch repair and boolean toggle use actual landed values. Complex converters, lists and nested models lack live coverage.
Basic glow transition rendered; broader animation types, blending and timing cases have no independent coverage.
Instructions cover resize and long/empty data; no live responsive typography/layout case has been run.
Added timing versus spacing, lead/follow, contacts, volume and loop velocity checks. Real-time performance review is still missing.
RML retains named native artwork and interactions. Editor import/opening is unverified.
Two concrete failures traced to the responsible input name and hit geometry rather than redrawing artwork.
ZIP backup integrity and unchanged source hashes were verified. Backup-discovery issue was corrected in the authoring entrypoint.
Independent reviewer found no required visual redesign but identified missed hit coverage and timing/handoff limits. Compliance, craft and handoff verdicts are now explicit.
Guidance exists; bones, weights, constraints, extreme poses and editable rig handoff have not been exercised.
Luau attachment repair is tested. New Luau algorithms, AnimaScript and WGSL remain unverified. Editor shader guidance no longer requires CLI compilation.
Local .riv files were produced; independent destination-runtime playback and native .rev export were not tested.
Headless pointer behavior is tested. Keyboard, semantics, reduced motion, actual device scale and assistive technologies are not.
Seven validator tests pass. Two added tests first exposed a crash on missing skills and an escaping README link; both corrected. Package and skill validators pass.
Stale-note and concurrent-edit handling is specified; real compaction/session-resume trial missing.
Manifest validation is not live client certification. No multi-client or multi-model behavior comparison.
Blocked-render probes and live empty-Editor session identify evidence limits. Host-specific unavailable-tool recovery is not exhaustively tested.
Retained artifacts and independent narrow tests exist. Missing representative creative corpus, reference fidelity, repeated sessions, real motion review and target-runtime checks.

new_regression.correction: One transparent hit-path changed from ellipse to rectangle in an isolated artifact; artwork unchanged.

coverage.threshold: maximum RGB channel difference >10 from background (48,35,51), excludes background dithering

new_regression.limit: Coverage analysis is raster evidence at 320x320, not exhaustive pointer dispatch at all pixels/scales.

changes: Required relevant creative-direction guidance for new/substantial artwork only
Added practical contour/composition and motion craft guidance
Separated compliance, craft and handoff review
Added intended hit-region and negative-input verification
Clarified Editor document preconditions, units and partial-result errors
Fixed two package validator defects with red/green tests
Documented readiness evidence and capability limits
next_required_evidence_for_high_tier_cla: Reference-driven artwork and multi-size typography/content cases
Real-time expressive motion and rig/deformation review
Live Editor mutation and actual native/destination export checks
Represented scripting lanes and shaders exercised
Automatic triggering and repeatability across claimed clients/models
